text:
marta: Quick heads-up — planned kernel ABI change will land in the night window (00:30 UTC). Putting up a short preflight thread for visibility.
eli: Thanks. Which packages are affected?
marta: runtime/engine and runtime/quant-kernels, plus the abidiff consumer tests. ABI bump is additive but we saw one flaky on p4d in staging earlier.
aditya: Can you paste the exact build tag?
marta: build tag: `ci/runtime-kernel@v2.9.0-abi202`
jenkins-bot: CI results for ci/runtime-kernel@v2.9.0-abi202: 124/127 passed. Failures: p4d-quant-gpu-integration (intermittent OOM). Full log: https://ci.redwood/integration/1234
sre-oncall: OOM on p4d sounds like a scheduler packing issue, not ABI. Any trace that it's an instruction mismatch?
marta: No illegal instruction traces. stack traces show kernel init allocate -> kv cache init -> OOM during matmul init.
kai: We should gate this behind the new safety-rail: deploy-bot pin on night-bucket + run smoke with full seq=2048, quant path, and eviction telemetry.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: night-bucket (2026-03-21 00:30 UTC). Canary slice: 1% for 15m, then 10% for 30m, then 100%. Rollback auto-thresholds: error-rate > 2% OR latency P95 increase > 25% OR mem OOMs > 0.
aditya: Can we tighten to 0% mem OOMs? I'd rather abort on any OOM during canary.
marta: Agreed. change deploy-bot thresholds to: mem OOMs > 0 -> immediate rollback.
deploy-bot: Updated rollout policy.
eli: We also need release notes blurb highlighting ABI bump + quant kernel pathing changes. Add known incompatibilities: old pinned vulkan graphs will be rebuilt.
jin: I'll draft release note: "Runtime kernel ABI v202: minor ABI additions enabling faster packed matmul; requires on-disk graph rebuild for pinned vulkan caches."
marta: Add migration step in notes: run `rwd-runtime-tools rebuild-graphs --all` after upgrade for Dedicated clusters.
sre-oncall: During canary, run extra telemetry: evict-rate, kv-cache-hit, allocator-failures, and p95/99 latency per model. I'll release a smoke script.
kai: Share smoke script here when ready. Keep it under 5 minutes.
sre-oncall: Pasting quick script snippet: ```bash
# quick smoke
rwd-smoke --models small,medium --seq 512 --quant --duration 4m --trace evict,kv,alloc
```
aditya: Also ensure we pin runtime image for Dedicated customers until we've validated. Communicate with sales/escalations.
marta: I'll update the dedicated-pinning job to pin v2.9.0-abi202 to dedicated-night until 2026-03-28 unless we get signoff.
eli: If canary passes but we see minor perf regression on XLA-like models, what's rollback policy? Full rollback or traffic-shift to compatible matmul-v1 kernel builds?
kai: We have fallback bundles: matmul-v1 and quant-compat-v1. deploy-bot can traffic-shift to fallback by model tag. I'll prepare a runbook to flip them per-region.
jenkins-bot: Staging smoke with full seq passed locally on g5x but p4d still has previous OOM flake (log attached).
marta: Ok plan: night rollout with immediate-oom-rollback + per-region hold if OOMs. If p4d shows OOM we pin back and open hotfix branch (runtime/patch-p4d-oom).
aditya: Who's on-call for the hotfix? @kai and @jin can own patch until morning.
kai: I'm on it, will start repro in p4d staging reserved slot at 21:00 UTC.
jin: I'll prep the branch template and changelog entry.
marta: Communication: I'll fire an announcement in #eng-releases and ping sales for Dedicated. Also update release notes draft link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2.9.0-abi202-draft
eli: One last ask — add a telemetry gating job to ensure no more than 0.5% latency regression on sample prod traffic before 100% rollout.
sre-oncall: Noted, will add gating job.
marta: Thanks all. If anyone sees new failures post-21:00 UTC ping this thread. I'll hold final go/no-go at 00:10 UTC. :thumbsup:
eli: +1
kai: +1
aditya: +1
deploy-bot: Canary started: night-bucket 1% -> monitoring.
deploy-bot: Canary metric alert: p4d-us-east-1 instance observed OOM at +7m -> rolling back region and pinning to previous image. Incident: RB-00087
marta: Received. Initiating hotfix branch and notifying on-call.
kai: Repro succeeded in reserved slot. Possible allocator path regression when sequence > 1024 under quant. Working on patch.
jin: Drafted changelog and hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/5023
aditya: Thank you team — keep updates here. I'll coordinate dedicated customer pins with Sales.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed for p4d-us-east-1. Canary continues in other regions.
marta: Final note: if no further OOMs by 00:50 UTC we'll continue gradual rollout; otherwise full rollback and RFC for longer stabilization window.
eli: A quick retro note: add a preflight run with p4d reserved slot in future ABI bumps. Learned the hard way.
marta: Agreed. Adding to release checklist. Closing thread when rollout completes.
